Runes › Domination

Grisly Mementos

DominationRow 2

Each champion takedown gives a memento (up to 18), and each memento makes your trinket come back faster.

What it does

Collect 1 memento on champion takedowns, up to 18 total. Gain 6 Trinket Haste for each collected. In game modes where vision Trinkets do not exist, instead gain 3 Summoner Spell Haste.

When to take it

Pick it over Sixth Sense when you expect to get many kills and assists and want to place or sweep wards more often. It does little if you are not fighting.
